title: La moitié manquante de la recette

scenes.title: Room Four Rings Twice
scenes.summary: Room 4's desk buzzer gives its signature double ring, and Odette brings the old green cloth botanical book downstairs to inspect with Claire and Henri.

scenes.title: Between the Mint Leaves
scenes.summary: In Room 9, Odette lifts the missing bottom half of the berry-and-almond cake recipe from between pressed mint leaves, though an old raindrop blurred the final line.

scenes.title: Three Small Baking Tins
scenes.summary: In the café kitchen, Nadia puts aprons on Thibault and Claire to bake three small test cakes with three different glazes.

scenes.title: Batch One Is Too Sour
scenes.summary: After Etienne measures the lemon glaze for Batch One without his reading glasses, Henri takes one bite and declares it sour enough to polish brass.

scenes.title: Batch Two Crunches Loudly
scenes.summary: Thibault unveils Batch Two with a heavy toasted sugar top so hard that his brother Antoine jokes he could use it to tile a courtyard roof.

scenes.title: Smelling the Pressed Page
scenes.summary: Holding the smudged recipe card up to the Room 9 window light with Odette, Nadia spots a tiny orange-blossom sketch and smells wildflower honey and sweet orange peel.

scenes.title: Ten Out of Ten in Pencil
scenes.summary: Nadia serves Tin Three brushed with warm honey and orange zest; Henri eats in silence, writes ten out of ten in his paper ledger, and asks for a second slice.

scenes.title: The Red Star Upstairs
scenes.summary: Sharing cake in the courtyard, Antoine compares the four-card puzzle map to the second-floor wooden balcony and spots an old brass lantern ring right where the red star points.
